name: BIST 5505
title: Applied Statistics I
description: (Also offered as STAT 5505.) Exploratory data analysis: stem-and leaf plots, Box-plots, symmetry plots, quantile plots, transformations, discrete and continuous distributions, goodness of fit tests, parametric and non-parametric inference for one sample and two sample problems, robust estimation, Monte Carlo inference, bootstrapping.
requirement_description: Open to graduate students in Statistics and Biostatistics; others with permission.
